<a name="Conflict"></a>
## type Conflict

Conflict represents a conflict detected during a three\-way merge.

```go
type Conflict struct {
    Path        string
    Key         string // Key of the conflicting item
    Index       int    // Index of the conflicting item
    Type        ConflictType
    OurValue    interface{}
    TheirValue  interface{}
    BaseValue   interface{}
    Description string
}
```

<a name="ConflictType"></a>
## type ConflictType

ConflictType represents the type of conflict.

```go
type ConflictType int
```

<a name="ConflictAttribute"></a>

```go
const (
    // ConflictAttribute indicates conflicting attribute changes.
    ConflictAttribute ConflictType = iota
    // ConflictText indicates conflicting text content changes.
    ConflictText
    // ConflictStructure indicates conflicting structural changes (children).
    ConflictStructure
)
```

<a name="Diff"></a>
## type Diff

Diff represents a difference between two elements.

```go
type Diff struct {
    Type       DiffType
    Path       string
    Key        string // Key identifies the changed item (e.g., attribute name)
    Index      int    // Index identifies the changed item in a list (e.g., child index)
    Message    string
    OldValue   interface{}
    NewValue   interface{}
    ChildDiffs []Diff
}
```

<a name="DiffType"></a>
## type DiffType

DiffType represents the type of difference between two elements.

```go
type DiffType int
```

<a name="NoDiff"></a>

```go
const (
    // NoDiff indicates no difference.
    NoDiff DiffType = iota
    // Added indicates an element was added.
    Added
    // Deleted indicates an element was deleted.
    Deleted
    // Modified indicates an element was modified.
    Modified
)
```

<a name="ElementMerger.Merge"></a>
### func \(\*ElementMerger\) Merge

```go
func (m *ElementMerger) Merge(base, other openxml.Element) error
```

Merge merges the changes from 'other' into 'base'. In a two\-way merge, this effectively makes 'base' identical to 'other' by applying all differences.

<a name="StrategyCombined"></a>
## type StrategyCombined

StrategyCombined resolves conflicts by combining values where possible. For text, it appends 'theirs' to 'ours'. For others, it defaults to 'ours'.

```go
type StrategyCombined struct {
    Separator string
}
```
